speaker: A1ZHYS5O0CKLXB
text: Hi, how are you today? I have a question for you, how interested are you in helping children in need?

speaker: A3M22VCNWJF2UE
text: Hi! I'm doing great, and yourself? I am very interested.

speaker: A1ZHYS5O0CKLXB
text: Im doing great too. A lot better than the children I speak of that are suffering in developing countries. Have you ever heard of the organization Save the Children?

speaker: A3M22VCNWJF2UE
text: No, I haven't. What is the organization about?

speaker: A1ZHYS5O0CKLXB
text: Save the Children is an international non-governmental organization that promotes children's rights, provides relief and helps support children in developing countries.

speaker: A3M22VCNWJF2UE
text: That sounds really interesting. What countries does Save the Children operate in?

speaker: A1ZHYS5O0CKLXB
text: It operates out of the United States, it actually helps children in the US and developing countries such as Ethiopia, Indonesia, Vietnam, and many more. Just a small amount, pennies, would make a huge difference to these kids.

speaker: A3M22VCNWJF2UE
text: I had no idea it operated outside of the United States. I understand how a donation, no matter how small would help this children. Do you know where the money goes towards to?

speaker: A1ZHYS5O0CKLXB
text: It would go into a general fund and the organization would put the money where it is most needed. Are you willing to make a small donation between fifty cents to two dollars that you would gain from this task to go toward this Charity?

speaker: A3M22VCNWJF2UE
text: I would be more than willing to give a donation. Before I do that, I would like to know how the organization handles the money. I have no doubt its a trustworthy organization, I just want to know how it helps the children.

speaker: A1ZHYS5O0CKLXB
text: The money goes towards their healthcare, their education, what tugs on my heart strings the most is that it also goes towards protecting the children from abuse and neglect, exploitation and violence. Of course it also helps feed needy children and goes towards emergency care for any type of natural disasters or other emergencies.

speaker: A3M22VCNWJF2UE
text: It does sound like the organization is helping improve and save children's lives

speaker: A1ZHYS5O0CKLXB
text: It is! Imagine if we convinced our friends and family to donate a small amount as well, people like you and I could actually make a difference in the world.

speaker: A3M22VCNWJF2UE
text: Yes! So many children around the world could have better an improved lives. Why is this organization not well known?

speaker: A1ZHYS5O0CKLXB
text: I have heard of it before but not extensively. I learned a lot about them through their website  URL How much would you like to donate? The research team will collect all donations and send it to Save the Children.

speaker: A3M22VCNWJF2UE
text: Thanks for sending me the website! I will check it out. I would like to donate .50.

speaker: A1ZHYS5O0CKLXB
text: You are a wonderful person, thank you for showing love to children in need.

speaker: A3M22VCNWJF2UE
text: I really wish I could donate more. Maybe one day when I have enough income I will.

speaker: A1ZHYS5O0CKLXB
text: I am in the same boat, but every penny counts and weather it is .50 cents or 500 you are making a difference. Thank you and have a wonderful day.

speaker: A3M22VCNWJF2UE
text: Thank you for all the information. Hope you also have a wonderful day.
